title: [Riso] TAC – Filter Accordion – Collapsed state – Location filter hidden
description: AC 04 — State Transition — Location is hidden with the other filters.
preconditions: HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce org.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff collapses the filter accordion.
steps_result: 1. The Location filter is hidden with the other filters.

title: [Riso] TAC – Filter Accordion – Expanded state – Location filter restored
description: AC 04 — State Transition — Location is available after expansion.
preconditions: HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce org.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff expands the filter accordion.
steps_result: 1. The Location filter is visible and available.

title: [Riso] TAC – Filter Accordion – Selected Location – Filtering retained
description: AC 04 — Regression — Accordion state change preserves the selected Location filter.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Riso Salesforce org.
Location Tokyo has calendar lessons.
steps_actions:
1. HQ or CM Staff selects Location Tokyo.
2. HQ or CM Staff collapses and expands the filter accordion.
steps_result:
1. The calendar shows lessons in Tokyo.
2. Tokyo remains selected and the same location-filtered lessons remain shown.
